name: My Pet Tabitha
source:
Main character is a talented student who creates a potion that instantly rises estrus. To his surprise, Tabitha volunteers to help with testing this potion. Will libido fully liberalize with erection active all day long? Is there a way back?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名天才学生，他创造了一种能立即发情的药水。令他惊讶的是，塔比瑟自愿帮助测试这种药剂。性欲会完全释放并全天勃起吗？有回去的路吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
